import warnings
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats
from scipy.stats._constants import _XMAX

probe("cauchy.logpdf(2e18)", float(stats.cauchy.logpdf(2e18)))
probe("cauchy.logpdf(1e200)", float(stats.cauchy.logpdf(1e200)))
probe("cauchy.logpdf(_XMAX)", float(stats.cauchy.logpdf(_XMAX)))

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    with np.errstate(all="warn"):
        pdf_1e200 = float(stats.cauchy.pdf(1e200))

probe("cauchy.pdf(1e200)", pdf_1e200)
probe("overflow_warnings_cauchy_pdf_1e200", sum(1 for w in caught if issubclass(w.category, RuntimeWarning)))
